decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already fully records that every completed mint contributes one ticket and one $5 commission to the leaderboard, with code-based or random attribution as applicable.
The current state already assigns one Small Block ticket for a coded referral and one random Small Block ticket when no referral code is used; the source does not change the prize mechanism.
The source specifically requires accounting on the leaderboard and NFT attributes and does not establish a new dashboard-summary rule.
The source does not change fiat-buyer wallet provisioning, authentication, dashboard access, notification, or reward-access behavior.
The source explains reward accounting and reports missing displayed rewards but does not request a change to About-page copy.
The source addresses on-chain NFT reward attributes rather than the separate frontend NFT-detail summary, whose existing general accuracy rule remains unchanged.
The current revenue-allocation state already requires a $5 affiliate commission for every primary mint, including no-code mints, and the source does not alter the $15 split.
The current state already requires a $5 commission from a successful no-code mint to be assigned to a random existing NFT holder; the source does not resolve the separate first-mint edge case.
The source concerns reward issuance and display at mint time and does not change how books, referral codes, badges, or tickets behave upon NFT transfer.
The source clarifies operational reward accounting but does not request a FAQ revision, and the approved FAQ state already covers random no-code rewards.
The reference to twelve completed mints establishes expected reward totals, not a change to public mint, pool, referral, or next-draw statistics.
The source does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear on the dashboard or how failed mint attempts are excluded.
